exploration_routes.name: The House That Outgrew the Blueprint
exploration_routes.story_lens: A shared plan becomes an impossible house; when its route disappears, they turn it over and draw only the next line.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: The painful recognition of being completely sure about a partner while unsure how to build the life around that love.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: Shared adulthood keeps producing decisions that commitment alone cannot answer.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu carries equal visible agency and expressive pressure without being reduced to chaos.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv carries equal visible agency without becoming a handler or rescuer.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: folded blueprint -> expanding rooms -> bleeding route -> blank reverse -> one new chalk line
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: The failed map is turned over instead of treated as evidence that the choice of partner was wrong.
exploration_routes.payoff: Commitment answers who; the couple keeps learning how through equal authorship.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Sendable to the person you remain certain of while both of you are still learning the life around that certainty.

stage_scene_gate.action: Aachu and Zuv jointly open, hold, turn over, and finally mark the same blueprint as the imagined house outgrows its instructions.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Their gazes divide under pressure, converge on the failed route, meet after the page turn, and align along one newly snapped line.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Attention moves from each other, to diverging shared-life demands, to the same failed plan, and finally to one shared next direction.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Equal ownership is visible in every beat: meeting hands, one plan corner each, one page corner each, and one chalk-line endpoint each.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The dead-end page turn creates the quiet pause in which failure stops reading as a verdict on the relationship.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: The ruined plan becomes a blank working surface without pretending the unfinished house is solved.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: They cannot draw the whole future, but they can author the next line together.

success_definition.audience_success: A cold viewer recognizes their own relationship and sends the deck to the person they are sure about.
success_definition.creative_success: The sequence reads silently as mutual choice, pressure, lost instructions, reinterpretation, and equal next-step authorship.
success_definition.brand_success: The route feels tender, observant, specific, and relationship-first rather than like a decorative quote card.
success_definition.production_success: Exact copy, Aachu/Zuv likeness, one tiny brandmark, 1080x1440 finals, visual QA, and final audit all pass.
